questions.question_text: Write 84% as a fraction in its lowest terms.
Work out (1 - 0.8)^2.
Find the value of x^2 - x when x = -3.
A quadrilateral has all sides equal and exactly two lines of symmetry. Write down the mathematical name of this quadrilateral.
Find the value of x.
On the Venn diagram, shade A U B.
Find the size of one interior angle of a regular polygon with 20 sides.
Find the value of |-4| + 4.
A van has length 9 m. It takes 1 second for the van to completely pass a gate of length 1 m. Find the speed of the van. Give your answer in km/h.
The faces of a die are numbered 1, 1, 2, 3, 3 and 4. When it is rolled it is equally likely to show any face. The die is rolled twice. Find the probability that it shows an odd number both times.
Here are the first five terms of a sequence. 1/4, 1, 4, 16, 64. Find the next term.
Here are the first five terms of a sequence. 1/4, 1, 4, 16, 64. Find the nth term.
Factorise. 1 + a - c - ac
The diagram shows two similar triangles, ABC and PQR. Find the length of PR.
The triangles are the cross-sections of mathematically similar prisms. The volume of the larger prism is 500 cm^3. Find the volume of the smaller prism.
A = P(1 + x)^3. Rearrange the formula to write x in terms of A and P.
Points Q, R, S and T lie on the circle. AB is a tangent to the circle at T. Angle RTB = 70 degrees. Find angle RQT.
p varies inversely as the square root of q. When q = 9, p = 12. Find p when q = 16.
Simplify by rationalising the denominator. 3 / (2\sqrt{2} - 1)
The diagram shows the graph of y = |ax + b|, where a > 0. Find the value of a and the value of b.
Write as a single fraction in its simplest form. 3 / (x - 2) - 2
2 log p = 3 log x - log y. Find p in terms of x and y.
